word.name: JSON schema for the concept of graph rules
word.title: JSON Schema for the Concept of Graph Rules
word.description: the json schema for the concept of graph rules

jsonSchema.name: graph rule
jsonSchema.title: Graph Rule
jsonSchema.description: JSON Schema for the concept of graph rules. Each element is one entry of the rulebook, docs/GRAPH_RULES.md, made from that entry and from the rule's code by src/firmware/graph-rules.js. Its text fields hold the rulebook's words as Markdown.

graphRule.name: graph rule
graphRule.title: Graph Rule
graphRule.description: One rule, as its rulebook entry and its code give it.

name.name: name
name.title: Name
name.description: The rule's name, from its entry's heading: kebab-case, and its code file's name when it has one

number.name: number
number.title: Number
number.description: The entry's number in the rulebook

says.name: says
says.title: Says
says.description: What the rule says, as the rulebook writes it (Markdown)

kind.name: kind
kind.title: Kind
kind.description: The entry's Kind, as the rulebook writes it (Markdown)

about.name: about
about.title: About
about.description: What the rule is about: the graph (its Kind starts "a graph rule") or events (it starts "a letter rule")

refusesOrReports.name: refuses or reports
refusesOrReports.title: Refuses or Reports
refusesOrReports.description: Whether the rule refuses a write or only reports, and its refusals, as the rulebook writes it (Markdown)

check.name: check
check.title: Check
check.description: How a check finds what breaks the rule (Markdown)

repair.name: repair
repair.title: Repair
repair.description: How a repair fixes what breaks the rule (Markdown)

enforcedBy.name: enforced by
enforcedBy.title: Enforced By
enforcedBy.description: Where the rule is enforced: by the database, a guard or a check, and where (Markdown)

status.name: status
status.title: Status
status.description: proposed (written, not yet enforced), enforced, or retired

source.name: source
source.title: Source
source.description: The TIP or ADR that brought the rule in (Markdown)

alsoSays.name: also says
alsoSays.title: Also Says
alsoSays.description: The entry's other fields, in order, each with its label and its text (Markdown); empty when there are none

code.name: code
code.title: Code
code.description: What the rule's code file declares, or null for a rule with no code file
